summary: iter329 — Verified ApprovedMakersTab shadowing-bug fix (renamed local `promoteToFounder` to `handlePromoteToFounder` so it no longer shadowed the imported API helper). Backend contract + full UI regression flow now pass end-to-end. 4/4 pytest tests green, all UI assertions green.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: renaming the local handler to `handlePromoteToFounder` (line 115 of ApprovedMakersTab.jsx) + updating the onClick at line 464 removes the shadowing. Inline comment (lines 107-113) documents the trap well.

Consider adding an ESLint rule `no-shadow` (or `import/no-unused-modules`) at the repo level — this same class of shadowing bug can silently reappear when a component grows large. Not required for this ticket but would prevent whole family of regressions.

ApprovedMakersTab.jsx is ~527 lines; nudging past the 700-line threshold, still within budget but starting to accumulate concerns (impersonation, promotion, purge, CSV export, Enrich Labs export, indexation chart toggle). A future refactor could split each admin action into its own hook — not blocking this bug fix.
test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via issue_admin_magic_token(OPS_EMAIL) then exchanged at POST /api/admin/auth/verify (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Seeded one test maker with slug 'ux-promote-fix-mtu386' (tier=standard) for the UI flow. Backend pytest fixture also seeds/tears down its own `ux-promote-fix-<rand>` maker per test. All seed data (makers + activity_events + email_log entries) cleaned up after the run — verified via subsequent delete_many sweep returning 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Approved-Makers tab promote flow is fully green. Route is /admin/dashboard?tab=approved-makers (NOT /admin?tab=…). Admin JWT injection into localStorage cm_admin_jwt works for direct-navigation UI tests. Regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter329_promote_founder.py — reuse them if the founders/promote endpoint is touched. ApplicationsList.jsx was NOT re-tested (main agent noted it wasn't touched by the fix); if a future change affects that entry point it should be re-covered.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: ES-module top-level `import { promoteToFounder }` was shadowed by a `const promoteToFounder = async …` declaration inside the same component's function body. Inside the handler, `await promoteToFounder(slug, {inaugural:true})` resolved to the local function via TDZ-scoped lookup, causing infinite self-recursion. The recursion showed a second confirm() containing the arguments object stringified ('[object Object]') and no POST to /api/admin/founders/promote. FIX: renamed local handler to `handlePromoteToFounder` (line 115) and updated the button's onClick (line 464). RE-VERIFICATION: exactly 1 confirm dialog, exactly 1 network POST, 200 response, table refreshes with founder badge visible.
